goal: Fix tests/packaged-contract-tool-surface.test.ts so a contract token present on zero Host tool surfaces is reported as a failure (the exact HTN-2 regression it exists to catch), and its pre-change comparison reads the actual pre-S1 file content instead of a hardcoded paraphrase.

acceptance.assertion: tests/packaged-contract-tool-surface.test.ts reports a contract token as a failure when it is present on neither CLAUDE_TOOLS nor PI_TOOLS (zero surfaces), not only when it is present on at least one.

The 'fails against pre-change contracts' case in tests/packaged-contract-tool-surface.test.ts reads the actual file content at the commit immediately preceding S1's first contract change (via git show <sha>^:<path> at test time) instead of a hardcoded paraphrase of the old text.
